info.title: Decision Engine
info.description:
Open-source payment gateway routing service by Juspay. Selects the optimal payment processor for each transaction in real-time using success-rate scoring, rule-based routing, and elimination logic.

## Authentication

This API supports two authentication methods:

1. **JWT Bearer Token** - For dashboard/user sessions
   - Header: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>`
   - Obtain via `/auth/login` endpoint

2. **API Key** - For service-to-service/programmatic access
   - Header: `x-api-key: DE_<64_char_hex>`
   - Create via `/api-key/create` endpoint

Protected endpoints require one of these authentication methods.

post.description:
Core routing decision API. Given a payment context and a list of eligible gateways, returns the optimal gateway to route to.

The engine applies a sequence of filters (currency, card brand, auth type, EMI, etc.) then scores remaining gateways using success rate history, elimination status, and contract obligations.

**Authentication:** Requires either JWT Bearer token or API Key.

AdminSecret.description: Admin bootstrap secret for creating merchant accounts

metadata.description: JSON-encoded string. Carries debit-routing inputs such as merchant_category_code, acquirer_country and co_badged_card_data.

channel.description: Acceptance channel: ecom / pos / contactless. Feeds the interchange-category predictor.

enableMultiObjective.description: Per-request override for the multi-objective (cost-aware) post-step. true forces it on, false forces it off; omitted falls back to the merchant's multi_objective_routing_enabled feature flag.

routing_approach.description: SR_SELECTION_MULTI_OBJECTIVE indicates the multi-objective post-step promoted a cheaper gateway over the SR head.

gateway_before_evaluation.description: Gateway the SR head selected before the multi-objective / debit-routing post-step replaced it.

status.description: Transaction status. Must be a TxnStatus value - lowercase values such as `success` are rejected.

errorInfo.description: Gateway error details for the GSM-based scoring filter. When present and the merchant flag is on, user/issuer-originated failures are skipped so the gateway is not penalised.

isSmartRetry.description: Set by the orchestrator when this call is a smart-retry attempt.

gsm_info.description: GSM lookup result. Present only when `errorInfo` was supplied and a matching rule was found.

algorithm_for.description: Activation slot for the rule. `payment` rules are evaluated by /routing/evaluate; `volume_commitment` holds the merchant's volume-contract configuration document and is required iff `algorithm.type` is `volume_contract`.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored with the rule.

data.description: Depends on type: array of ConnectorInfo ({gateway_name, gateway_id}) for `priority`, single ConnectorInfo for `single`, array of {split, connectors} for `volume_split`, Euclid AST Program for `advanced`, A/B experiment config for `ab_test`, VolumeContractConfig document for `volume_contract` (requires `algorithm_for: volume_commitment`; amounts are canonicalized to integer minor currency units and tolerance to basis points on write).

created_by.description: Merchant that owns the routing rule.

fallback_output.description: Connectors to fall back to when no rule matches.

parameters.description: Map of rule-builder key to typed value. A null value means the key is present but unset.

merchant_id.description: The merchant whose dashboard to enter.

query.description: Matched against member email and merchant name (substring, case-insensitive) or an exact merchant id. Minimum 2 characters.

MultiObjectiveInfo.description: Present when the multi-objective (cost-aware) post-step ran. Explains why the gateway was picked: the SR head was kept (AUTH_WON) or a higher economic-value PSP was promoted (COST_WON). Economic value is auth rate × settlement value, where settlement value = txn amount − cost of payment processing (acquirer, issuer & network fee).

reason.example: Promoted 'adyen' over 'stripe' on expected value — saves 80.00 bps for 3.00pp auth.

srHead.description: The PSP the SR scorer would have picked.

chosen.description: The PSP the post-step actually chose. Equals srHead when auth won.

costSavedBps.description: Fee saved in bps when outcome is COST_WON (srHead.costBps - chosen.costBps).

qualifiedCount.description: Number of PSPs that had cost data and were ranked on expected value.

margin.description: Merchant margin (fraction of ticket) applied for this transaction. Configured via the successRate config margin field; defaults to 1.0.

evGapTop2.description: Expected-value gap between the top-two EV-ranked PSPs, as a fraction of ticket. Null when fewer than two PSPs had cost data.

ConnectorInfo.description: A connector as referenced by routing rules. `gateway_id` is the merchant connector account id and may be null.

value.description: Shape depends on `type`: a number for `number`, a string for `enum_variant`/`str_value`/`global_ref`, `{key, value}` for `metadata_variant`, and an array for the `*_array` variants.

ValueType.description: Tagged rule-builder value. Discover the valid keys and their allowed values with `GET /config/routing-keys`.

output.description: Raw output of the matched rule, tagged by algorithm type (`priority`, `single`, `volume_split`, `advanced`).

RoutingDictionaryRecord.description: Summary record returned when a routing rule is created.

algorithm_data.description: The stored algorithm, tagged by `type` with the variant payload under `data`. See `RoutingAlgorithm`.

JsonifiedRoutingAlgorithm.description: Full routing algorithm record as returned by the list endpoints.

orderReference.description: Full internal order object. `merchantId` inside it identifies the merchant.

orderMetadata.description: Full internal order-metadata object. Required. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

txnDetail.description: Full internal transaction object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

txnCardInfo.description: Full internal card/payment-method object. Note: `partitionKey` must be PRESENT in this object (it may be `null`). It is an `Option` field with a custom `deserialize_with` and no `serde(default)`, so serde requires the key even though the value is nullable.

LegacyDeciderRequest.description: Legacy decider payload built from full internal transaction objects. This is NOT the `/decide-gateway` shape. The endpoint rejects the `/decide-gateway` body with a 400. `orderMetadata`, `txnDetail` and `txnCardInfo` must each carry a `partitionKey` key (value may be null).

id.description: Numeric string. Must be present and parse as an integer - the conversion unwraps the parsed value, so a missing or non-numeric id panics the handler instead of returning a 4xx.

LegacyUpdateScoreRequest.description: Legacy score-feedback payload built from full internal transaction objects. This is NOT the `/update-gateway-score` shape. `txn_detail` and `txn_card_info` must each carry a `partitionKey` key (value may be null), and their `id` fields are numeric strings.

api_key.description: Default API key minted for the new merchant. Shown only once.

source.description: `autopilot` for entries managed by the auto-calibrator. Absent for human-authored ones.

SRSubLevelInputConfig.description: Per-dimension override. Only the dimensions you set are used to scope the override.

margin.description: Merchant margin as a fraction of ticket, used by the multi-objective expected-value ranking.

data.description: Variant payload selected by `type`. Fields are camelCase.

RuleConfigGetResponse.description: `POST /rule/get` returns the stored config without a `message` field.

HybridRoutingRequest.description: At least one of `static_routing_request` or `dynamic_routing_request` must be provided.

dynamic_routing.description: Decision-gateway result, wrapped as `{status, decision, fallback_connectors}`.

evaluated_connectors.description: Connectors clients should consume. Prefer this over the per-branch outputs.

values.description: Comma-separated list of allowed values, for `enum` keys.

keys.description: Map of routing-key name to its metadata.

is_super_admin.description: This user's email is on the platform super-admin roster (may enter any merchant by ID).

is_super_admin_view.description: The current session is a super-admin viewing another merchant's dashboard.

token.description: Refreshed JWT scoped to the new merchant.

RoutingEvent.description: Fields marked 'omitted when absent' are skipped entirely rather than serialised as null.

delta_pp.description: Variant minus control auth rate, in percentage points.

AddonDto.description: A connector's stored invoice add-on. The add-on fields are flattened alongside `connector`.

lo.description: Inclusive lower bound of the amount range this piece prices.

key.description: Opaque cluster key, used in the override PUT/DELETE path.

n.description: Transaction count. 0 for an override-only cluster no longer in the top set.

effective_pct_bps.description: Null when the cluster has no usable rate at all.

verdict.description: `GOOD`, `THIN`, `NON_LINEAR`, or `""` for an override-only cluster. A non-GOOD rate is shown so it can be corrected - it is not what the router trusts.

card_product.description: Issuer BIN's dominant interchange rate as integer bps (`"115"`), or `""` when the report carried no PAN.

segments.description: Recovered per-segment rates for a capped/tiered cluster. Empty for an ordinary GOOD cluster.

ClusterOverride.description: Cluster dimensions are flattened into this object alongside the override values.

account.description: First configured connector-side account, when credentials are set.

model_pct_bps.description: Model-derived blended fee, volume-weighted over GOOD clusters.

effective_pct_bps.description: The fee actually used at decide time.

tiered_clusters.description: One line can't price it, but its recovered amount tiers can.

good_txn_pct.description: Share of transactions with a trustworthy single-line model.

priced_txn_pct.description: Share of transactions the router can price: GOOD plus TIERED.

priced_gross_pct.description: Share of settled volume the router can price. The real coverage headline.

invoice_subtotal.description: Invoice subtotal excluding taxes - the true all-in cost.

model_captured.description: What the fit alone captured over the settled book.

webhook_secret_hint.description: `—` when no credential blob is stored or decryptable.

MaskedSource.description: Connector credentials with secrets masked. Secrets are never returned in full.

changed_on.description: Snapshot date the new price first appeared.

webhook_secret.description: Secret used to verify inbound webhook signatures.

download_auth.description: Report-download credential: either Basic auth as `user:password`, or a Report Service API key on its own (sent as `X-API-Key`).

merchant_id.description: Attach the new user to an existing merchant.

DeciderErrorResponse.description: Error envelope returned by the gateway-decision routes.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Generic API error envelope: an error code, a human-readable message, and an optional structured payload.
